summary: Mayfair Marks is a boutique tax and advisory firm in Surry Hills, Sydney, with about 7 staff, offering bookkeeping, tax planning, SMSF, business advisory and Virtual CFO services. Founder and Director Spiro Markopoulos previously built MPK Accountants into a firm of over 5000 clients. Spiro has been emailed twice already (16 and 23 Nov 2026), so this follow-up takes a new angle.
